description: Application-layer dual-model clean baseline. No attack, no privacy stack, no defence. FedProx on Edge-IIoTset application-layer partition.

architecture_detail.cnn_block_1: Conv1d(1, 64, k=3, pad=1) -> BatchNorm1d(64) -> ReLU -> MaxPool1d(2)
architecture_detail.cnn_block_2: Conv1d(64, 128, k=3, pad=1) -> BatchNorm1d(128) -> ReLU -> MaxPool1d(2)

model.critical_feature_note: Application model must retain ALL 52 raw features including HTTP/MQTT fields before VarianceThreshold. Removing these caused SQL_injection and XSS to score F1=0.000 for 20 rounds (root cause: HTTP features are the only discriminative signal for application-layer attacks). VarianceThreshold then reduces to 40.

dataset.name: Edge-IIoTset DNN subset
preprocessing_steps: Drop columns: frame.time, ip.src_host, ip.dst_host, tcp.options, tcp.payload, mqtt.conack.flags, mqtt.msg, mqtt.protoname, mqtt.topic, Attack_label
Cap DDoS_TCP to 18% of total (VARS-FL methodology)
dataset.data_scarcity_note: SQL_injection (1001 samples) and Uploading (1214 samples) are genuinely rare in the dataset. No algorithmic fix can overcome this fundamental scarcity — F1 ceilings are hard limits imposed by data availability, not model weakness.

convergence_notes.sql_injection_note: 0.810 F1 at round 25. Surprisingly strong given only 1001 samples — HTTP features provide discriminative signal. However small test sets mean this number is noisy (Client 1 has 1 SQL_injection test sample — getting it right gives F1=1.0).
convergence_notes.uploading_ceiling_reason: Client 1 has only 23 Uploading training samples and 6 test samples — hard ceiling regardless of algorithm. Cannot be improved without more data.
convergence_notes.fingerprinting_note: 0.4825 F1 — limited by Dirichlet starvation. Some clients receive 0 Fingerprinting samples.

results.sql_injection_jump_note: SQL_injection jumped from 0.49 to 0.81 around round 19. Genuine improvement but partly inflated by small test set sizes.

vars_fl_benchmark.note: Application model (0.660) exceeds VARS-FL on the harder application-layer subset with 10x fewer clients and 4x fewer rounds.
